note: The same four layers with a SilhouetteEnhancementVolumeStyle: samples with no gradient (the two end layers) are dropped; on the axis (N . V = 1) the opacity is retainedOpacity, so with the defaults (1) the middle layers draw as plain 55, and with retainedOpacity 0.2 they are faint (about 187).
gaps: a constant volume draws nothing with this style whatever the parameters (X_ITE 16.6.0 drops every sample with no gradient)
the opacity is the alpha of a sample times the factor; nearly-saturating stacks hide small errors, so the faint case is the one that discriminates
